About us

A kitchen for every craving

Forno e Forchetta is takeaway and home delivery in Monterotondo, Mentana and Fonte Nuova.

Instead of one huge menu that does a bit of everything, we chose to split things up: pizza, piadine, oven-baked pasta, sandwiches and schiacciata, roast chicken, fried street food, Asian food, kebab, work lunches and bowls each have their own kitchen and their own menu. That way every dish stays what it should be, and you find what you feel like eating right away.

How we work

1One kitchen, one craft

Each kitchen prepares only its own menu. No dishes added just to fill the list.

2Clear ingredients

You see the ingredients of every dish and, where available, you can add the extras you like.

3Close to you

We deliver locally, and if you have a request just write to us: we reply as soon as we can.

Where we deliver

Mentana, Tor Lupara, Fonte Nuova and Santa Lucia (00013), Monterotondo and Monterotondo Scalo (00015). Order from the site, choosing the kitchen you prefer.
